estimates.assumptions: 1 tbsp (14g) neutral cooking oil (e.g. vegetable/olive); pure fat, no carbs
1 whole medium chicken (~1.5kg raw, skin-on, bone-in); pure meat/skin, no carbs
1 large onion (~150g chopped raw weight); standard onion carb values
1 medium red pepper (~120g chopped raw weight); standard pepper carb values
3 garlic cloves (~15g crushed); standard garlic carb values
225g chorizo sausage (standard cured Spanish-style); low-carb cured meat
1 tbsp tomato puree (~15g); standard tomato paste carb values
1 tbsp chopped fresh thyme (~3g); standard fresh herb carb values
150ml dry white wine; residual sugars after fermentation
800ml chicken stock (standard low-fat broth); minimal carbs from bones/veg
400g uncooked white rice (long-grain or paella rice; dry weight); standard white rice carb values (~80g carbs/100g)
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley (~8g); standard fresh herb carb values
